thread:
maria-cs: Morning team — quick status on Seabreeze private/VPC onboarding. Renewal window in ~45 days; CSM flagged elevated risk because KMS rollover + delayed audit log delivery. Need alignment on remaining blockers so we can update the renewal score.

sam-eng: Quick question — which KMS model are they using? They said CMEK in their account, rotation 180 days? We need the exact key ARN and the service role ARN to add to the policy.

maria-cs: Yes @sam-eng — they confirmed CMEK in their AWS. Rotation cadence: 180 days. Key ARN is in the ticket but I'll paste the trimmed ARN once I have it. Customer asked for cross-account grants to redwood-service role.

seabreeze-admin: Confirmed from our side. Key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Rotation set to 180 days. Also: audit logs must forward to our Splunk collector, retention 24 months, and egress must be allowed to 198.51.100.25/32. IAM: need least-privilege role for model pull and execution.

ali-ops: For the egress rule I can open TCP 443 to 198.51.100.25/32 from the private subnets and add VPC endpoints for S3/KMS. Will push the firewall rule today and validate.

jess-ps: On the KMS side we need the key policy to explicitly allow kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt for arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/redwood-service. Also document the rotation/runbook for their SREs so they can approve.

sam-eng: Small test for Splunk connectivity: curl -v https://splunk-collector.seabreeze.example/health  — note they use a private CA, may need CA bundle or proxy. @seabreeze-admin can you confirm TLS chain?

seabreeze-admin: Uploaded the cert bundle to the ticket (ticket #CS-4821). TLS currently uses an internal CA; we can provide intermediate chain. Also procurement asked about SLA credits for first 30 days post-cutover — will flag with account team.

deploy-bot: deployment/privnet-seabreeze finished — env=staging status=success ts=3391234600 :rocket:

maria-cs: OK blockers recap: 1) KMS policy update awaiting customer IAM approval; 2) Splunk TLS handshake failing until cert chain is accepted by our forwarder; 3) procurement/renewal question about credits — finance needs to weigh in. If we don't get KMS + logs in next 72h, bump renewal risk.

ali-ops: I'll open the egress rule and run a test payload to Splunk EOD. Command I'll use: curl -X POST 'https://splunk-collector.seabreeze.example/services/collector' -H 'Authorization: Splunk <token>' -d '{"event":"privnet test"}' — will paste results here.

jess-ps: I'll draft the handoff doc (keys + rotation, cert refresh playbook, IAM role matrix, audit log retention config). Expect first draft in ~4 hours and will share link.

sam-eng: If we need a temporary workaround for certs we can proxy logging through our collector and do TLS termination on our side until their CA is onboarded. That avoids blocking the cutover. Fernanda in infra said proxy capacity is fine for a short window.

maria-cs: Good option, @sam-eng. For renewal risk I updated SF to "Medium" for now. Once KMS + Splunk verified we can move back to Low.

seabreeze-admin: We're coordinating internally to approve the minimal key policy and will reply by EOD. Thanks for the proxy option — will accept as interim if needed.

maria-cs: Thanks all. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done so I can close the loop with the customer and update renewal scoring. I'll follow up in the ticket after the egress test.
